title: obr: Access 'Office for Budget Responsibility' Data — obr-package
text: Provides clean, tidy access data published 'Office Budget Responsibility' ('OBR'), UK's independent fiscal watchdog. Covers Public Finances Databank (outturn PSNB, PSND, receipts, expenditure since 1946), Historical Official Forecasts Database (every 'OBR' forecast since 2010), Economic Fiscal Outlook detailed forecast tables (five-year projections latest Budget), monthly profiles public finances ('OBR' forecast apportioned across months fiscal year), Welfare Trends Report (incapacity benefit spending caseloads), Fiscal Risks Sustainability Report (50-year state pension projections). returned objects carry provenance metadata recording source URL, publication vintage, retrieval time, file fingerprint, analyses can audited reproduced. Data downloaded 'OBR' first use cached locally subsequent calls. Data sourced 'OBR' website https://obr.uk.
